facts.claim: Prefer user-facing locators, `getByRole` with an accessible name first; avoid CSS selectors such as classes because the DOM changes.
facts.goal: testing-blocks: Playwright locates via the a11y tree
facts.verified: https://playwright.dev/docs/locators ('prioritize user-facing attributes ... page.getByRole()'; 'CSS and XPath are not recommended as the DOM can often change'), https://playwright.dev/docs/best-practices#use-locators
facts.question: Which kinds of locators are recommended for selecting elements in a Playwright test, and in what priority?

facts.claim: Wait for `.<block>[data-block-status="loaded"]`. The block class is in the delivered markup before any JS runs, so waiting for `.<block>` alone doesn't mean it's decorated.

facts.claim: Every committed file is publicly served unless `.hlxignore` matches it, so committed test files need an `.hlxignore` entry.
facts.verified: aem-boilerplate@5cea543 AGENTS.md:21 ('All committed files are served. Use `.hlxignore`.'), .hlxignore:L7 (`test/*`)

facts.claim: Boilerplate projects lint with `npm run lint` (ESLint airbnb-base + Stylelint) and autofix with `npm run lint:fix`; the boilerplate's GitHub workflow runs `npm run lint` on every push.
facts.question: How do you lint an EDS boilerplate project locally, fix what can be fixed automatically, and where else does lint run?

facts.claim: `aem up` proxies pages it can't find in `./content/` from the preview site (`main--<repo>--<owner>.aem.page` by default), so that content only shows locally after it's been previewed.
facts.verified: @adobe/aem-cli@16.22.16 src/up.cmd.js:L220 (default url 'https://main--{{repo}}--{{owner}}.aem.page'), src/server/HelixServer.js:L473-478 (content/ first), src/server/BaseServer.js:L161-163 ('Serving content from local content/, proxying missing files from ...')
facts.question: Where does the AEM CLI dev server get page content from, and why might a page an author just edited not show up locally?

facts.claim: Each pushed branch is served at `https://<branch>--<repo>--<owner>.aem.page/`; special characters (e.g. `/`) become `-`, and `<branch>--<repo>--<owner>` must fit in 63 characters (one DNS label).
facts.verified: https://www.aem.live/docs/network-profile#dns-scheme ('Special characters ... replaced by a single -', 'maximum length of a domain name label is 63 characters'); https://www.aem.live/docs/limits (`ref--repo--owner` 63 characters); @adobe/aem-cli@16.22.16 src/up.cmd.js:L211-217
facts.question: After pushing a feature branch `feature/new-hero` of an EDS project, at what URL can you test it, and what limits apply to that URL?
